title: Document page blocks, islands and family footer on the Papyrus marketing site (p.apyr.us)
description: Follow-up, not part of the core story: describe the new standard front end features (page blocks, islands, brand and nav groups, family footer) on the Papyrus marketing site.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live 2026-10-21: https://p.apyr.us/standard-front-end.html (and its .md twin, 200 text/markdown) has the section on page blocks, islands, brand and nav groups, family footer, clean URLs and the 5.12.0 options (Papyrus-web PR #20, e685dbb, Amplify job 18 SUCCEED). Only behaviour that the core docs describe and that was seen live is claimed: blocks/islands on cyclotron, chattic, tactus; family footer on Cyclotron and Tactus only.
